name: Google
note: One of the largest IT suppliers; makes far more than the search engine it is known for

name: Mozilla
note: A non-profit foundation rather than a company in the usual sense

name: Microsoft
note: Makes an operating system, a browser and a search engine — a good reason not to equate a maker with one kind of thing

name: Apple
note: Makes devices, an operating system and a browser

name: Apache Software Foundation
note: A foundation, not a firm — the same distinction Mozilla already makes in this list, and a reason a maker is not always a company

name: Signal Foundation
note: A non-profit; the thing it makes is often named as if it were the organisation

name: Telegram (company)
note: The firm and the app carry the same name, which is exactly the confusion this system is about — and it made the explanation read „Telegram ist ein Messenger von Telegram.“ The suffix is a DISAMBIGUATION of this inventory, not part of the name: the legal entity is Telegram FZ-LLC / Telegram Messenger Inc., which is not written here because it is not verified. No row of this system may assert something unchecked.

name: Meta
note: Owns WhatsApp, and is itself better known under the name of another of its products
